title: Explore shows the whole market, ordered hood, town, market, online, with towns by adjacency

criteria.text: Every locality-scoped surface (Explore, Home, search, unclaimed, report queue) shows one market: the vantage's, the member's home by default
criteria.note: Not built: scope is still a metro (`?metro=`, cookie, member default, else `DEFAULT_METRO_SLUG`), picked in `src/lib/browse/scope.ts`; #1484 adds an IP-guessed open market for a signed-out visitor with none, still a metro, not the vantage's market [V]. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V grep, git log since 11-20]: no adjacency table, no `ST_Touches` in src or migrations, no market scope or bands; `resolveFeedMetro` and `DEFAULT_METRO_SLUG` (Sacramento) unchanged in `src/lib/feed/feed-metro.ts`. #1484 (11-26) admits a signed-out visitor to an open market by IP within 45 miles, which is market admission (F081), not F104 scope or order. Search rings (#1425, open, change) widen one search hood, town, area, beyond and are separate from this scenario by its own note. Open #696 (deferred).

criteria.text: Inside the market: hood, town, towns by adjacency, rest of the market, online last; county remainder counts as a town; bridge table
criteria.note: Not built: no adjacency, bridge table or bands [V grep]; the stand-in is #932's drive-time rings from the home town's centroid, order inside by recency and `mixRuns`. Search rings (#1425, open, change) widen one search hood, town, area, beyond and are separate from this scenario by its own note. Open #697 (deferred).

criteria.text: Locality on a card, a Page or any surface is a neighbourhood or town name: no miles, minutes, hop count or 'near you'
criteria.note: Not built, and one more surface since 11-20: #1484 (11-26) put "Showing {market}, near you." and "SocialUs isn't open near you yet." on Explore itself (`BrowseSurface.tsx:428`, `:391`), draft words the PR leaves to the PM [V]. Also still: `venueDistanceMeters` on `/p/[...slug]`, "What's happening near you" (`HomeFeed.tsx`), "near you" in the site description, manifest, og image and push copy, "Near You" in the unimported `MarketSelector.tsx` [V grep]. Cards on Explore show no distance [V]. No standing guard. Open #697 (its checklist names the guard); the new Explore words are in the PM queue.

criteria.text: Explore's reach line and the How far filter say nothing in minutes; no drive-time rings
criteria.note: Retired: Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #796 and #922, built in #932, supersedes F104 criterion 3 for Explore's reach line only; minutes may show there and How far sets the ring. The reach line left Explore with #1161; How far stays in the filter sheet [V `filters.ts`]. Shown, not counted.
